name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted photo gallery that indexes a photo folder into albums, a timeline, places and faces, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: The first visitor creates the admin account on the setup page: open the app right after deploying and enter /photos as the photo path.
Photoview has no upload feature. Copy your photos and videos into the photoview-photos volume (mounted read-only at /photos), then run a scan from the settings page.
